name: forge-release
description: Release-PR setup across forges. The forge-release skill picks the tool (yeet for SemVer and CalVer on GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps; release-plz for Cargo packages) and covers setup, migration from release-please, troubleshooting and release-triggered deploys, with templates. github-app-create registers the release GitHub App in two browser clicks and stores its credentials (gh, pulumi or a SOPS Secret file; --public and --user-token for an App installed across accounts).
